release_notes: Orbitra 2.1.6: server_setup adds an adaptive swapfile safety net (1-4 GiB based on free disk space) for low-RAM VPSes with no active swap; Conversions log table gets server-side sorting, Reports-style alignment, and ellipsis clipping with hover tooltips; Sources table gets sortable, resizable tracker-table columns with clipped cells; Offers toolbar search box aligned.
